track.note: same evaluation cells, seed discipline (paired across detectors), detection window [onset-1, onset+12] and clean-cell false-alarm accounting as the step benchmark; only the injected rate trajectory changes. Knobs are re-picked inside the same realised budget for every reported budget (1/2/3/5%), and the fixed-knob delta repeats the headline comparison at the step-model picks.

claim_audit.claim: detect_v1/REPORT.md section 5: 'The naive rate-multiplier is the strongest detector at every reported false-alarm budget on the primary panel and on the domain panel.'

meta.description: independent reproduction of experiments/detect_v1/benchmark.json and injection-model sensitivity (ramp/transient/heterogeneous)

injection_models.heterogeneous: factor m on a Bernoulli(0.5) random subset of post-onset months, else baseline
injection_models.ramp: factor 1+(m-1)*min(1,(i-onset+1)/12) for i>=onset, then flat at m
injection_models.step: post-onset counts ~ Poisson(multiplier * trailing-12m baseline rate); pre-onset unchanged
injection_models.transient: factor m for months onset..onset+5, then baseline; all post-onset months re-drawn
